input.quote: 14.10 Complete Understanding. This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position: no non-solicit, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant binds Corio (our party) anywhere in this Agreement. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "recruit", "induce" and "employ" return no hiring restriction; a sweep of every "shall not" obligation surfaces only IP, confidentiality, trademark and covenant-not-to-sue restrictions; and every "personnel" reference (§ 3 demo access, § 5 training, §§ 13.1-13.3 shared operations/consulting/engineering resources, Exhibit D §§ 4-5) is an access or staffing provision rather than a restrictive covenant. The only personnel-adjacent terms are § 13.5's Commerce One employee NDA/invention warranty, § 14.5's independent contractor language and Exhibit D § 5's staffing commitment, none of which limits Corio's freedom to solicit or hire Commerce One personnel. The deterministic checks for a ≤12-month duration and a general-solicitation carve-out fail only because there is no restrictive covenant to qualify; that supports compliance rather than a deviation. One residual diligence point, not a deviation: § 14.10 incorporates a separately executed Non Disclosure Agreement and Statement of Work that are not part of this document, so we should confirm neither contains a non-solicit. If Commerce One later proposes one, our fallback is a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
